item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00153","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C10","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 is a strong direct drafting antecedent: it is an earlier memorandum to the same audience about the same Savings Bond payroll plan and committee, and the child reuses its distinctive sequence and language concerning national economic welfare, widespread distribution of the national debt, Federal employees' leadership, the committee as a promotional vehicle, and support for its chairman. C10 is also materially connected because it created the precise committee machinery that the child says the new order continued and superseded, but C09 more closely templates the later memorandum's prose and exhortational structure. C07 has a loosely parallel appeal for agency cooperation with a named campaign leader but lacks the distinctive subject matter and language necessary to qualify independently.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The maintenance of stability in the economic life of the individual, the community and the Nation, is well served by the widespread distribution of the national debt through the purchase of United States Savings Bonds by the people.","parent_excerpt":"The nation's economic welfare requires the widest possible distribution of the national debt through the continued sale of United States Savings Bonds to the people.","explanation":"Distinctive shared rationale linking national economic welfare to broad distribution of the national debt through Savings Bond purchases."},{"child_excerpt":"Federal employees should be encouraged to maintain their leadership in the purchase of Savings Bonds through the Payroll Savings Plan","parent_excerpt":"it is important that Government employees continue their leadership in the purchase of Savings Bonds through the Pay Roll Savings Plan.","explanation":"Near-verbatim reuse of the central appeal to Federal employees."},{"child_excerpt":"This Committee provides a vehicle for the effective promotion of the Payroll Savings Plan.","parent_excerpt":"The Interdepartmental Savings Bond Committee ... provides a vehicle for the effective promotion of the Pay Roll Savings Plan.","explanation":"Highly distinctive, nearly identical description of the committee's function."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge that each of you give Mrs. Priest your full support and cooperation in carrying on the work of the Committee.","parent_excerpt":"I therefore request that each of you give the fullest cooperation to the Chairman, Mr. Edward F. Bartelt ... in the work of the Committee.","explanation":"Same closing administrative request, adapted to the newly appointed chair."}]}
